subject: Important Update: Company Policy Changes
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you about some important changes to our company policies regarding remote work and attendance. Starting next month, all employees will be required to work from the office at least three days a week. We believe this adjustment will enhance collaboration and productivity within our team. Please review the updated policy document attached to this email and reach out if you have any questions. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
